Everyone has problems. Even the people you envy.

Kevin Trudeau says there is not one person on earth without obstacles, disasters or setbacks. Most people just never talk about theirs.

He quotes Earl Nightingale: successful people are not people without problems. They are simply people who learned how to overcome them.

So the next time you feel singled out by a tough season, remember you are in very good company. The difference is what you do next.

When did you last assume everyone else had it easier than you?

Kevin's free training, Your Wish Is Your Command, is in my highlights.

#ad #mindset #success

Henry Ford was one court ruling away from losing it all.

Kevin Trudeau tells it plainly. Ford was making cars when he got sued and told he could not make them anymore. If he lost, his business was finished. He fought in court and he won.

Kevin points out that the ultra successful faced disasters far bigger than most of our problems. He asks how they faced them and what their mindset was.

The problem in front of you is probably smaller than you think.

What would you do if your whole business hung on one decision?

Kevin's network for money and success thinking (GIN) is in my highlights.
